tc.loading.zh: 正在读取这台电脑的设置…

tc.sub.en: Titles, launches and stats are shared. The films folder and the tools for cutting films are this computer's own.
tc.sub.zh: 剧集、投放和数据是共用的；影片文件夹和剪片工具只属于这台电脑。

tc.settingsOff.en: This server keeps no settings for the computer, so nothing here can be changed.
tc.settingsOff.zh: 这个服务器不保存电脑设置，这里的内容无法修改。

tc.films.fromServer.zh: 来自 Studio 服务器设置

tc.films.none.en: No films folder yet. Importing and cutting films need one; everything else works without it.
tc.films.none.zh: 还没有影片文件夹。导入和剪辑影片需要它，其他功能不受影响。

tc.films.useSuggested.en: Make a new one for me

tc.films.hint.en: Paste the folder's whole path: an empty or new folder, or the one that already holds your films. "Make a new one" creates {suggested}.
tc.films.hint.zh: 粘贴文件夹的完整路径：可以是空文件夹或新文件夹，也可以是已经存放影片的文件夹。“帮我新建一个”会创建 {suggested}。

tc.pipeline.no_films_folder.en: Connect a films folder first; the pipeline goes beside it.
tc.pipeline.no_films_folder.zh: 请先连接影片文件夹，流水线会放在它旁边。

tc.pipeline.not_git.en: The pipeline folder is not a download from GitHub; Studio cannot update it.
tc.pipeline.not_git.zh: 流水线文件夹不是从 GitHub 下载的，Studio 无法更新它。

tc.pipeline.no_scripts.en: The pipeline is here but has no cut-only scripts.
tc.pipeline.no_scripts.zh: 流水线已在本机，但缺少仅剪辑路线的脚本。

tc.pipeline.dirty.en: has changes of its own, so Studio will not update it
tc.pipeline.dirty.zh: 本机有未保存到 git 的改动，Studio 不会更新它

tc.task.pull.done.en: The pipeline is up to date.

tc.task.packages.running.en: Installing the Python packages… (a few minutes)
tc.task.packages.running.zh: 正在安装 Python 组件…（需要几分钟）

tc.task.packages.failed.en: The Python packages did not install.

tc.ready.importOk.zh: 导入已完成的影片已经可以用。

tc.ready.importNo.en: Importing needs the films folder and ffmpeg too.
tc.ready.importNo.zh: 导入也需要影片文件夹和 ffmpeg。

tc.check.ffmpeg.filters.en: This ffmpeg lacks what the pipeline uses: {detail}; install the full build
tc.check.ffmpeg.filters.zh: 当前 ffmpeg 缺少流水线用到的功能：{detail}，请安装完整版

tc.check.ffprobe.bad.en: ffprobe is not installed (it comes with ffmpeg)
tc.check.ffprobe.bad.zh: 未安装 ffprobe（随 ffmpeg 一起安装）

tc.check.bash.bad.en: Git Bash is not installed (it comes with Git for Windows)
tc.check.bash.bad.zh: 未安装 Git Bash（随 Git for Windows 一起安装）

tc.check.ai.ok.en: AI key for the picture check
tc.check.ai.ok.zh: 画面检查的 AI 密钥已设置

tc.check.ai.bad.en: No AI key for the picture check in Studio's settings
tc.check.ai.bad.zh: Studio 设置里没有画面检查用的 AI 密钥

tc.packages.hint.en: The first cut also downloads the speech model once (about 1.5 GB).
tc.packages.hint.zh: 第一次剪片时还会下载一次语音模型（约 1.5 GB）。

tc.cloud.label.en: Films imported here, in the cloud

tc.cloud.hintOn.en: Each film imported here is copied to Supabase, one file at a time, so the other computer can play and cut it too.
tc.cloud.hintOn.zh: 本机导入的每部影片会逐个文件复制到 Supabase，另一台电脑也能播放和剪辑。

tc.cloud.hintOff.en: Turn this on so the other computer can play and cut the films imported here. It needs the Supabase Pro plan: the free plan holds only 1 GB, and 50 MB per file.
tc.cloud.hintOff.zh: 打开后，另一台电脑也能播放和剪辑本机导入的影片。需要 Supabase Pro 套餐：免费套餐只有 1 GB，每个文件最多 50 MB。

tc.cloud.elsewhere.en: {n} on the computer that imported it, not uploaded yet
tc.cloud.elsewhere.zh: {n} 个在导入它的电脑上，尚未上传

tc.cloud.tooBig.en: {n} files are over Supabase's file size limit (largest {largest}). Raise the limit under Storage → Settings in Supabase; they upload on their own after.
tc.cloud.tooBig.zh: {n} 个文件超过 Supabase 的单文件上限（最大 {largest}）。请在 Supabase 的 Storage → Settings 里调高上限，之后会自动上传。

seg.elsewhere.note.en: This film is being cut on {computer}. Its folder, pictures and reviews are on that computer: open Studio there to review or stop it. You can follow its stage from here.
seg.elsewhere.note.zh: 这部影片正在 {computer} 上剪辑。它的文件夹、画面和审核都在那台电脑上，请在那里打开 Studio 审核或停止。你可以在这里查看进度。
